findings.text: blocking: _lifted_backends resolves the lift with readings=None and no session, unlike every other caller of budget_lift.effective_budget (reckon/budget.py:2651 passes the group's window history, reckon/crew/budget_group.py:210 passes history and session), so _reset_observed (budget_lift.py:816) returns False and a reset-anchored lift reads as in force after the pace path has ended it, while _applies (budget_lift.py:710) refuses every session-scoped lift so a session lift never reaches the reflex; the reflex can therefore disagree with the snapshot about the same lane, which is the parity the done_when requires.

follow-on: the file is written although it is not among the node's nine declared write paths; the repair is legitimate (the enlarged guidance pushes the default hold fixture past HOLD_PAYLOAD_INLINE_LIMIT) but the record must be widened or the diff carries an out-of-scope edit.

follow-on: test_an_open_node_may_still_hold_on_a_zero_slot_lane supplies action hold, which _zero_slot_lane (dispatch_picker.py:520) short-circuits before the role and spec checks at dispatch_picker.py:624, so no assertion fails if _ZERO_SLOT_REASK_ROLES or _ZERO_SLOT_REASK_SPEC_LEVELS is removed.

follow-on: the lane derivation (the local marker, else _backends.dialect_for) is copied from reckon/crew/picker/snapshot.py:890 into a second reader, so a change to one silently leaves the re-ask excluding the wrong backend set.

follow-on: the after_suite command field reads "cd <worktree> && PYTHONPATH=<worktree> ...", so the record's own command is not the literal command the store expects even though log_path resolves to a log whose header carries it.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit from 91f8944b0725d3eb7a7f874a456fb879790960f9 to ebcb2cbc4436cb3f65bebd74bd54a37f74f1b4e0; five commits touch 8 files, and the recorded gate delta is corroborated by gate-base.log and gate-head-round2.log, which show the same two congested-lane failures and the same single setup error on both sides.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names tests/test_jev_routes_with_the_session_admission_and_the_lift.py and a base/head gate over the importers of the changed modules; the file exists at 479 lines with 9 tests, and the manifest records both arms with their logs.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is that Jev's rendered state and guidance carry the session's own worker slots and any lift in force; reckon/crew/picker/snapshot.py:815 renders Candidate.worker_slots through the one allowance helper for every backend whose router publishes a lane document and rides the budget group's lift on the candidate's congestion block, with the wording added at reckon/crew/picker/prompts.py:59 and in reckon/crew/picker/templates/questions.jinja:1.
item_verdicts.manifest: read at runs/r-20261015T075223938148-jev-routes-with-the-session-admission-and-the-lift/manifest.md; status complete, and it records the commits, the two gate logs, the negative control, and the write-scope entry as its own follow-on.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the node declares nine write paths; the diff writes eight, and one of them, tests/test_hold_records_its_state.py:162, is not among the declared nine.

justifications.durability: tests/test_jev_routes_with_the_session_admission_and_the_lift.py:336 cannot fail on the specification gate it names, so the role and spec-level branches of reckon/crew/dispatch_picker.py:624,566 are unguarded.
justifications.evidence: the gate named in the manifest ran at both arms and its delta (2 failed of 856 base, 2 failed of 866 head, no added id) holds in gate-base.log and gate-head-round2.log, but the ruff obligation is asserted in the manifest checkpoint with no log recorded and the after_suite command carries placeholders.
justifications.fit: the helpers added at reckon/crew/dispatch_picker.py:508-600 follow the surrounding module's naming and comment style and introduce no plan, sprint or ticket identifier.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/picker/snapshot.py:815-837 carries the session's slots for every lane_document backend and the group's lift on congestion, which is what the goal asks Jev to see.
justifications.reuse: reckon/crew/picker/snapshot.py:273 and reckon/crew/recovery_review_dispatch.py:1096 both extend existing owners, but the lane-to-backends derivation is stated twice at snapshot.py:890 and dispatch_picker.py:553.
justifications.scope_discipline: the diff is inside the declared nine except for the hold-row repair at tests/test_hold_records_its_state.py:162, which was not granted, and the manifest discloses that entry rather than carrying it silently.
